speculation.sentence: She ___ be tired — she didn't sleep at all last night.

speculation.sentence: That ___ be John at the door — he's in Australia this week.

speculation.sentence: Don't call her now; she ___ be having a shower.

speculation.sentence: Peter ___ a new car — I saw him in a red sports car yesterday.
speculation.explanation: Posibilidad en el pasado → may + have + participio.

speculation.sentence: I can't find my keys. I ___ them at the office.
speculation.explanation: Posibilidad en el pasado → might + have + participio.

speculation.sentence: Lois ___ a shower when you arrived — that's why she didn't open the door.
speculation.explanation: Acción en progreso en el pasado → may + have been + V-ing.

speculation.sentence: You ___ (be) hungry after such a long walk! Let me make you something.
speculation.explanation: Deducción positiva en presente → must + inf.

speculation.sentence: He ___ the money — he was with me all day.
speculation.explanation: Certeza negativa en el pasado → can't + have + participio (nunca mustn't have).

speculation.sentence: It ___ rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella just in case.
speculation.explanation: Muy probable en el futuro → may + well + inf.

speculation.sentence: He ___ won the competition — he was by far the best.
speculation.explanation: Muy probable en el pasado → may + well + have + participio.

speculation.sentence: If you don't study, you ___ fail the test.
speculation.explanation: Certeza en el futuro → be bound to + inf (no hay modal).

speculation.sentence: He was ___ to win the lottery — the odds were one in a million.
speculation.explanation: Be unlikely + to inf = poco probable.

speculation.sentence: There is a strong likelihood ___ tomorrow.
speculation.explanation: Likelihood + of + (sujeto) + V-ing.

speculation.sentence: There is a slight likelihood ___ the match.
speculation.explanation: Likelihood + that + oración.

speculation.sentence: Real Madrid ___ win the league this year; they have the best squad.
speculation.explanation: Should + inf = mucha probabilidad / expectativa, pero no seguro.

speculation.sentence: She ___ not be at the library; she sometimes studies at home.
speculation.explanation: Posibilidad negativa → may / might + not (can't sería imposible).

speculation.sentence: The lights are off. They ___ (go) to bed already.
speculation.explanation: Deducción positiva sobre el pasado → must + have + participio.

speculation.sentence: You ___ have seen Tom at the party; he's been in hospital all week.
speculation.explanation: Imposible en el pasado → can't + have + participio.

speculation.sentence: The parcel ___ arrive by Friday, although there could be delays.
speculation.explanation: Expectativa razonable (pero no segura) → should.

speculation.sentence: Don't worry, they ___ (well / be) stuck in traffic.
speculation.explanation: Muy probable ahora → may / might / could + well + be.

modals.sentence: You ___ wear a seatbelt in the car; it's the law.
modals.explanation: Obligación por ley → must.

modals.sentence: I ___ work late yesterday because my boss asked me to.
modals.explanation: Must no tiene pasado → had to.

modals.sentence: You ___ come if you don't want to — it's optional.
modals.explanation: Falta de obligación → don't have to.

modals.sentence: You ___ smoke in hospitals; it's strictly forbidden.
modals.explanation: Prohibición → mustn't.

modals.sentence: My parents made me ___ the dishes every night.
modals.explanation: Make + alguien + inf sin to.

modals.sentence: I was made ___ (wait) outside for an hour.
modals.explanation: En pasiva: be made + TO inf.

modals.sentence: As I trained every day, I ___ run the marathon in under four hours.
modals.explanation: Logro concreto en el pasado → was able to (no could).

modals.sentence: When I was a child, I ___ run really fast.
modals.explanation: Habilidad general en el pasado → could.

modals.sentence: After hours of trying, she finally ___ to open the jar.
modals.explanation: Manage + to inf (succeed va con in + V-ing).

modals.sentence: He succeeded ___ (pass) the exam at the third attempt.
modals.explanation: Succeed + in + V-ing.

modals.sentence: I ___ passed the test, but I wasn't fast enough.
modals.explanation: Habilidad que no se usó → could + have + participio.

modals.sentence: My parents never let me ___ out late.
modals.explanation: Let + alguien + inf sin to.

modals.sentence: Visitors are not permitted ___ photographs inside the museum.
modals.explanation: Be permitted / allowed + to inf.

modals.sentence: You ___ have studied a lot more — you failed again!
modals.explanation: Crítica sobre el pasado → should + have + participio.

modals.sentence: It's raining a lot. You ___ take an umbrella.
modals.explanation: Had better + inf sin to (si no, consecuencia negativa).

modals.sentence: You ___ (better / not) be late again, or you'll be fired.
modals.explanation: Negativa: had better + not + inf.

modals.sentence: It was a sunny day, so I ___ take a taxi; I walked home.
modals.explanation: No era necesario y NO lo hice → didn't need to.

modals.sentence: You ___ bought so much food — only four people came.
modals.explanation: Lo hiciste, pero no era necesario → needn't + have + participio.

modals.sentence: There's nothing on TV. We ___ as well go to bed.
modals.explanation: Might / may / could as well = da igual, ya que estamos.

modals.sentence: You ___ at least have said thank you!
modals.explanation: Queja: could / might + at least + have + participio.

conditionals.sentence: If you heat water to 100°C, it ___.
conditionals.explanation: Verdad universal → zero conditional (present + present).

conditionals.sentence: If you study more, you ___ (pass) the test.
conditionals.explanation: 1st conditional: if + present, will + inf.

conditionals.sentence: If I ___ more money, I would travel around the world.
conditionals.explanation: 2nd conditional: if + past simple, would + inf.

conditionals.sentence: If I ___ you, I would apologise.
conditionals.explanation: If I were you → consejo (were para todas las personas).

conditionals.sentence: If I ___ harder, I would have passed the exam.
conditionals.explanation: 3rd conditional: if + past perfect, would have + participio.

conditionals.sentence: ___ I studied more, I would have passed the exam. (inversión)
conditionals.explanation: Inversión del 3rd conditional: Had + sujeto + participio.

conditionals.sentence: ___ you apply for the job, you will be hired.
conditionals.explanation: Inversión del 1st conditional: Should + sujeto + inf.

conditionals.sentence: If you ___ to take the bus, you'll arrive on time.
conditionals.explanation: If + happen to + inf = si por casualidad (menos probable).

conditionals.sentence: If I ___ to have more free time, I would go to the park more often.
conditionals.explanation: If + were to + inf (2nd conditional más improbable).

conditionals.sentence: ___ I to win the election, I would reduce taxes.
conditionals.explanation: Inversión: Were + sujeto + to + inf.

conditionals.sentence: If I had eaten breakfast, I ___ hungry now.
conditionals.explanation: Mixed (3rd → 2nd): pasado que afecta al presente (now).

conditionals.sentence: If I were taller, I ___ a pilot years ago.
conditionals.explanation: Mixed (2nd → 3rd): situación general que afectó al pasado.

conditionals.sentence: If she ___ (not / miss) the train, she would be here now.
conditionals.explanation: Mixed: if + past perfect, would + inf (now).

conditionals.sentence: If he spoke English, he ___ the job last year.
conditionals.explanation: Mixed (2nd → 3rd): if + past simple, would have + participio.

conditionals.sentence: ___ the traffic had been lighter, we would have arrived on time.
conditionals.explanation: Con had ya en la oración no se invierte: If + past perfect.

conditionals.sentence: If you ___ see Anna, tell her I called.
conditionals.explanation: If + should + inf = si por casualidad.

conditionals.sentence: Had I known about the party, I ___ (come).
conditionals.explanation: 3rd conditional (inversión): would have + participio.

conditionals.sentence: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic.
conditionals.explanation: 1st conditional: nunca will en la parte del if.

conditionals.sentence: When you mix blue and yellow, you ___ green.
conditionals.explanation: Zero conditional: when + present, present.

conditionals.sentence: If I ___ to lose my job, I'd move back to my hometown.
conditionals.explanation: If + were to + inf, would + inf.

wish.sentence: You can borrow my car ___ you drive carefully.
wish.explanation: As long as = siempre y cuando (condición estricta).

wish.sentence: We'll miss the train ___ we leave right now.
wish.explanation: Unless = if not (a menos que).

wish.sentence: Hurry up, ___ we'll be late.
wish.explanation: Otherwise = de lo contrario.

wish.sentence: I wouldn't go out with him ___ he were the last man on Earth.
wish.explanation: Even if = incluso si (el resultado no cambia).

wish.sentence: ___ your help, I would have failed the exam.
wish.explanation: But for + sustantivo = si no fuera por.

wish.sentence: Were it not ___ the rain, we would go out.
wish.explanation: Were it not for + sustantivo (presente).

wish.sentence: Had it not ___ for the rain, we would have gone out.
wish.explanation: Had it not been for + sustantivo (pasado).

wish.sentence: They agreed to lend us the money ___ that we paid it back within a year.
wish.explanation: On condition that = con la condición de que.

wish.sentence: I wish I ___ more money.
wish.explanation: Wish + past simple → cambiar el presente.

wish.sentence: If only I ___ near the beach!
wish.explanation: If only + past simple → situación presente.

wish.sentence: I wish I ___ harder for the exam last year.
wish.explanation: Wish + past perfect → arrepentimiento del pasado.

wish.sentence: I wish my brother ___ taking my things without asking!
wish.explanation: Wish + would → molestia por el comportamiento de otro.

wish.sentence: I wish I ___ go to Javi's party, but I have to work.
wish.explanation: Wish + could → falta de posibilidad.

wish.sentence: I wish I ___ (be) taller.
wish.explanation: Wish + past simple; con be → were (was es informal).

wish.sentence: I wish you ___ so much noise — I'm trying to sleep!
wish.explanation: Wish + would (not) → queja sobre lo que hace otro.

wish.sentence: If only I ___ told him the truth — now he hates me.
wish.explanation: If only + past perfect → arrepentimiento.

wish.sentence: I wish I ___ speak Chinese.
wish.explanation: Wish + could → falta de habilidad.

wish.sentence: We'll go to the beach ___ it rains — we love the rain! (2 words)
wish.explanation: Even if = incluso si.

wish.sentence: I wish I ___ to the concert last night. Everyone says it was amazing.
wish.explanation: Last night → pasado → wish + past perfect.

wish.sentence: You can stay here ___ you don't make a mess.
wish.explanation: Provided (that) = siempre que.

transformations.lead_in: I'm sure he didn't steal the money.

book.sentence: With so few customers here, you ___ be making much money.

book.sentence: The heavy rain this region experiences ___ regularly lead to the river bursting its banks.

book.sentence: She just ___ have time to get to the shops before they close.
book.explanation: Just might = posibilidad remota.

book.sentence: Your qualifications are excellent, so you ___ have no difficulty on this course.

book.sentence: No, sir. I've never been to Budapest. You ___ have made a mistake.

book.sentence: There's ___ possibility that this year will see economic conditions worsen.

book.sentence: I'd better make a note of that. Otherwise I ___ easily forget it.

book.sentence: I need to look at your car a bit more, but it ___ be possible to repair it.

book.sentence: Sorry, I can't come out tonight. My teacher said I ___ finish this essay.

book.sentence: I ___ catch a train home. My brother's picking me up.

book.sentence: You ___ go to the lecture this afternoon. It's optional.

book.sentence: These tablets will make you feel better, but you ___ take more than two at a time.

book.sentence: The meeting will be quite informal, so you ___ wear a suit.
book.explanation: No es necesario → needn't.

book.sentence: I fell asleep with the radio on. When I woke up, I ___ hear it — the battery was flat.
book.explanation: Imposibilidad en el pasado → couldn't.

book.sentence: I climbed into the back and ___ to open the boot from the inside.

book.sentence: The current is very strong today, so if you don't stay close to the coast, you ___ carried out to sea.

book.sentence: If you ___ moaning for a while, we might start to enjoy the holiday.

book.sentence: If you ___ a seat in the waiting room, the dentist will call you in a few minutes.

book.sentence: If we ___ the forest that day, Jake would never have met you.

book.sentence: Even if I ___ some spare cash at the moment, I wouldn't book one of those package holidays.

book.sentence: Provided you ___ in a committed way, you should reach the level of fitness you want.

book.sentence: If you ___ during the lesson yesterday, you would know the answer now.
book.explanation: Mixed: pasado (yesterday) que afecta al presente (now).

book.sentence: Correct the mistake: If you ___ (take) these photos, I wouldn't have remembered our holiday. (negative)
book.explanation: 3rd conditional → if + past perfect.

book.sentence: Correct the mistake: If I ___ (feel) tired, I usually go to bed early.

book.sentence: If we don't reduce our dependence on fossil fuels, global warming ___ (become) a more serious problem.

book.sentence: If the petrol engine hadn't been invented, there ___ (still / be) plenty of oil left now.

book.sentence: If you keep on working hard, I think you ___ (promote) next year.

book.sentence: If you hadn't insisted on leaving so early, we ___ (not walk) around the airport now with nothing to do.

book.sentence: She would be running the marathon next week if she ___ (keep) to her training plan over the last few months.

book.sentence: If the weather hadn't improved on the second day, last week's holiday ___ (ruin).
book.explanation: 3rd conditional en pasiva.

book.sentence: If you hadn't paid the man on the door, we ___ (not allow) to watch the rest of the film.
book.explanation: 3rd conditional en pasiva.

book.sentence: Katie wishes she ___ (work) harder when she was at school.
book.explanation: Arrepentimiento del pasado → wish + past perfect.

book.sentence: I wish I ___ (find) the present I bought for my mum. It must be here somewhere.

book.sentence: I wish my sister ___ (be) so untidy. Her bedroom is always a mess. (negative)
book.explanation: Situación presente → wish + past simple.

book.sentence: If only you ___ (tell) me when you were going to arrive. I'd have come to meet you.
book.explanation: Pasado → if only + past perfect.

book.sentence: I wish you ___ (not keep) interrupting me.
book.explanation: Molestia por lo que hace otro → wish + wouldn't.

book.sentence: If only I ___ (not turn down) that job offer. I'd be working in Milan now.
book.explanation: Arrepentimiento del pasado → if only + past perfect.

book.lead_in: David said he won't give me a promotion, but I think he might.

book.lead_in: The car is going to break down on this journey. I'm certain of it.

book.lead_in: I can't believe that the building is still standing.
book.explanation: Should have + participio = lo esperable era que hubiera pasado.

book.lead_in: Do you think it might rain later tonight?
book.explanation: Is there any chance of + (sujeto) + -ing?

book.lead_in: We're going to win tonight. I'm certain of it.

book.lead_in: I believe that in the near future it will be possible for people to live on other planets.
